points.title: 法律求学
points.description: 甘地在伦敦大学学院学习法律，接受西方教育。这段经历让他接触到了西方思想，但也让他更加意识到自己的印度身份。他在伦敦期间严格遵守素食主义原则，并加入了素食协会，结识了多位思想激进的素食者和改革者，这些经历为他后来的非暴力抵抗思想奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Gandhi studied law at University College London, receiving a Western education. This period exposed him to Western ideas but also reinforced his sense of Indian identity. In London, he strictly adhered to vegetarianism and joined the Vegetarian Society, where he met radical vegetarians and reformers whose ideas would later influence his philosophy of nonviolent resistance.

points.title: 抗争觉醒
points.description: 甘地在南非担任律师期间，亲身经历了种族歧视。他领导印度社区进行非暴力抗争，创立了'真理力量'（Satyagraha）理念。在南非的21年间，他组织了多次抗议活动，反对针对印度人的歧视性法律，包括著名的'苦力征召法'抗议。这段经历磨练了他的非暴力抵抗策略，为他后来领导印度独立运动积累了宝贵经验。
points.descriptionEn: While working as a lawyer in South Africa, Gandhi experienced racial discrimination firsthand. He led the Indian community in nonviolent resistance and developed the concept of 'Satyagraha' (truth force). Over 21 years in South Africa, he organized numerous protests against discriminatory laws targeting Indians, including the famous protest against the 'Indian Relief Act'. This period honed his nonviolent resistance strategies, providing valuable experience for his later leadership in India's independence movement.

points.title: 本土实践
points.description: 甘地回到印度后，在艾哈迈达巴德建立了非暴力抵抗学院，并开始推行'纺车运动'，倡导印度人抵制英国纺织品，恢复传统手工业。他领导了多次非暴力抗议，包括著名的'食盐进军'。这一时期，他发展出'非暴力不合作'理念，强调通过和平手段实现政治和社会变革。艾哈迈达巴德成为他思想和实践的重要基地，影响遍及整个印度。
points.descriptionEn: After returning to India, Gandhi established a nonviolent resistance institute in Ahmedabad and initiated the 'Khadi' (spinning wheel) movement, encouraging Indians to boycott British textiles and revive traditional handicrafts. He led numerous nonviolent protests, including the famous 'Salt March'. During this period, he developed the philosophy of 'non-cooperation', emphasizing peaceful means for political and social change. Ahmedabad became a crucial center for his ideas and practices, influencing all of India.

points.title: 食盐进军
points.description: 1930年，甘地领导了震惊世界的'食盐进军'，从艾哈迈达巴德步行到海边，自制食盐以抗议英国垄断盐业。这一非暴力行动激发了全国范围内的反英情绪，数百万人加入抵制英国货物的运动。尽管甘地最终被捕，但食盐进军成为印度独立运动的标志性事件，向世界展示了非暴力抵抗的力量，也使甘地成为国际知名人物。
points.descriptionEn: In 1930, Gandhi led the world-famous 'Salt March', walking from Ahmedabad to the sea to make salt in protest against the British salt monopoly. This nonviolent action sparked nationwide anti-British sentiment, with millions joining the boycott of British goods. Although Gandhi was eventually arrested, the Salt March became a landmark event in India's independence movement, demonstrating the power of nonviolent resistance to the world and making Gandhi an internationally recognized figure.

points.title: 狱中岁月
points.description: 甘地因发起'退出印度'运动被英国当局逮捕，在浦那的阿迦汗宫被软禁两年多。尽管身陷囹圄，他仍通过绝食等方式继续抗争，并思考印度的未来。这段狱中岁月让他有机会反思印度教-穆斯林关系问题，为后来的印巴分治做准备。尽管他反对分治，但最终接受了现实，并致力于缓解教派冲突。
points.descriptionEn: Gandhi was arrested by British authorities for launching the 'Quit India' movement and held under house arrest at the Aga Khan Palace in Pune for over two years. Despite his imprisonment, he continued his resistance through hunger strikes and contemplated India's future. This period allowed him to reflect on Hindu-Muslim relations, preparing for the eventual partition of India. Although he opposed partition, he eventually accepted reality and worked to mitigate communal conflicts.

points.title: 最后岁月
points.description: 印度独立后，甘地致力于促进印度教徒和穆斯林之间的和平共处。他多次进行绝食抗议，要求归还穆斯林难民被占财产，并前往德里难民营安抚难民。1948年1月30日，甘地在德里进行晚祷时，被一名印度教极端分子纳图拉姆·戈德森枪杀，终年78岁。他的遇刺引发了全国哀悼，也标志着一个时代的结束。
points.descriptionEn: After India's independence, Gandhi worked to promote peace between Hindus and Muslims. He undertook several hunger strikes demanding the return of property to Muslim refugees and visited Delhi refugee camps to comfort them. On January 30, 1948, while attending evening prayers in Delhi, Gandhi was assassinated by a Hindu extremist, Nathuram Godse, at the age of 78. His assassination triggered nationwide mourning and marked the end of an era.

supporter.zh: 甘地被尊为'圣雄'，是印度独立运动的灵魂人物和精神领袖。他倡导的非暴力抵抗思想影响了全球民权运动，包括马丁·路德·金和曼德拉。甘地的'真理力量'理念强调通过道德力量而非暴力实现社会变革，他的纺车运动和简单生活方式象征着印度自给自足的精神。甘地不仅是政治领袖，更是道德导师，他的思想至今仍对和平运动和可持续发展理念产生深远影响。
supporter.en: Gandhi, revered as 'Mahatma' (Great Soul), was the spiritual leader of India's independence movement. His philosophy of nonviolent resistance influenced global civil rights movements, including those led by Martin Luther King Jr. and Nelson Mandela. Gandhi's concept of 'Satyagraha' emphasized achieving social change through moral force rather than violence. His Khadi movement and simple lifestyle symbolized Indian self-sufficiency. Gandhi was not just a political leader but a moral teacher whose ideas continue to impact peace movements and sustainable development.

critic.zh: 批评者认为甘地的非暴力理念在现代社会过于理想化，难以应对复杂的现实挑战。有人指责他对印度教传统过于保守，阻碍了社会现代化进程。此外，甘地在二战期间对英国的支持以及对印度教-穆斯林关系的处理方式也备受争议。批评者还指出，他的经济政策过于强调乡村自给自足，忽视了工业化的重要性，导致印度独立后经济发展缓慢。这些批评反映了甘地思想的复杂性和历史局限性。
critic.en: Critics argue that Gandhi's nonviolent philosophy was overly idealistic and ill-suited to complex modern challenges. Some accuse him of being too conservative regarding Hindu traditions, hindering India's modernization. Additionally, his support for Britain during WWII and his handling of Hindu-Muslim relations are controversial. Critics also note that his economic policies overemphasized rural self-sufficiency at the expense of industrialization, contributing to India's slow economic development after independence. These criticisms reflect the complexity and historical limitations of Gandhi's thought.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，甘地被同时视为政治家、哲学家和道德象征。他的形象超越了国界，成为全球和平与正义的标志性人物。历史学者普遍承认甘地非暴力抵抗策略的有效性，同时也分析其思想的历史背景和局限性。在流行文化中，甘地经常被简化为'和平使者'的形象，但严肃的历史研究更关注其复杂的政治策略和思想演变。甘地的遗产是双重的：他既是一位成功的民族解放运动领袖，也是一位具有深远道德影响力的思想家。
objective.en: In academia and popular culture, Gandhi is viewed simultaneously as a politician, philosopher, and moral symbol. His image transcends national borders, becoming an iconic figure of global peace and justice. Historians generally acknowledge the effectiveness of Gandhi's nonviolent resistance strategies while analyzing the historical context and limitations of his thought. In popular culture, Gandhi is often simplified as a 'peace messenger', but serious historical research focuses more on his complex political strategies and ideological evolution. Gandhi's legacy is dual: he was both a successful leader of national liberation and a thinker with profound moral influence.

self.zh: 以眼还眼只会让整个世界变得盲目。
self.en: An eye for an eye will only make the whole world blind.

others.zh: 后来，我们记住了他的话语，却忘记了他是如何活出这些话语的。他活出了他的信念，他的生活就是他的信息。
others.en: Later, we remembered his words, but forgot how he lived them. He lived his beliefs, his life was his message.
